units.title: Unit – I AC Drive Fundamentals
topics:  AC drive classification.  Basic working principle of AC Drives general equations of induction motors.  General AC drive specifications.  AC motors
Speed- Torque characteristics of a induction motor  Basics of Speed control methods of AC motors: stator voltage

units.title: Unit – II Stator Voltage control Drives
topics:  Advantages of squirrel cage induction motor drives.  Working of AC voltage controller for 3-Ø induction motor with sketches.  With a block diagram describe the closed loop speed control of motor using stator voltage control.  With sketches
describe working of four quadrant AC voltage controller  State merits and demerits of stator voltage control

units.title: Unit – III Rotor Frequency control drives
topics:  Variable frequency characteristics of induction motor.  Working of variable frequency speed control.  Working of VSI fed drive with the help of sketches.  Breaking and multi quadrant operation of voltage source inverter fed drive for induction motor.  Working of CSI fed drive.  Explain braking and multi-quadrant operation of CSI fed drive.  Differentiate between VSI and CSI circuits.  Cyclo-converter fed drive with the help of sketches.  PWM inverter fed drive with the help of sketches

units.title: Unit – IV Rotor-side control of Drives
topics:  concept of conventional rotor resistance control method.  working of static rotor resistance control of doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) with sketches.  Super synchronous speed control using DC link cascade and cycloconverter cascade
Program Name: Diploma Engineering Level: Diploma Branch: Power Electronics Subject Code : DI05024011 Subject Name : AC Motor Drives  Close loop control of static Scherbius drive using block diagram

units.title: Unit – V Synchronous motor drives
topics:  working of load commutated inverter (LCI) fed synchronous motor drive with sketches.  working of close loop control of LCI fed synchronous motor drive using block diagram.  working of VSI fed synchronous motor drive using sketches.  working of cycloconverter fed synchronous motor drive using sketches
